blocks.source: Staniesz się pomarszczona, stara, zmęczona i smutna o wiele szybciej, jeżeli zawsze będziesz taka ekscentryczna i zrzędliwa!
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nie mogę cię winić, skoro spałaś na tak smutnym, zimnym, twardym drewnie...
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Jak widać tak to jest jak się komuś ślepo ufa.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hej, nie powiedziałem, że to ty.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Powinienem wiedzieć, że odpowiadanie na wezwania nadętych arystokratów to będzie strata czasu.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Żegnaj! Nie chce załapać twojej szlachetnej nudy~
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Zanim możesz wypowiedzieć następne słowo, twój wzrok pochłania ciemność.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Czemu? Co się dzieje? O co chodzi?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Ale wiesz, że twoje życie ci ucieka.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...I tak po prostu, już go nie ma.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nie wiem. To ty mnie wezwałaś.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: To ty mnie tu wezwałaś. Wredoto
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Widzisz tu kogoś innego? Nie? Więc kto inny mógł to zrobić?
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wowza. W sumie, to to było całkiem przyjemne.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Chyba obudziłaś w nim coś niefortunnego.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Znowu go klepiesz w policzek nie wkładając w to serca.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nie jestem zainteresowany twoim sercem, ale-
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Kładzie dłoń na swojej klatce piersiowej i kłania się.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Błazen, Demon Zdrady i Koszmarów do twoich usług.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mam zamiar spełnić twoje najgłębsze pragnienie... {i}Pani{/i}
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Po jego słowach, czujesz ostre ukłucie w swojej głowie.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Droga do potępienia? Czy bezsensowna śmierć?
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Razem, pozostawiali za sobą zniszczenie i cierpienie.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, ależ jaką piękną symfonie zemsty ze sobą tworzyli!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm... Możesz mnie nazywać Błaznem. Yup.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Pachniałaś taaak dobrze, więc przyleciałem tutaj jak wygłodniały sęp!
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Niewinna dusza zepsuta przez zemstę to taki rzadki przysmak.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Pogarda aż się z ciebie wylewała.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Zgaduje, że wysiorbałem trochę za dużo z ciebie i zabrałem również twoją pamięć... ojej.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tak tak! Na tak fajnym wózku. Sprawmy, żeby pędził dalej!
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Nie rozumiem ani jednego słowa które mówisz.
blocks.speaker: youpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: O, jak słodko z twojej strony! Aż się rumienie.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: O, niezły z ciebie wesołek, czyż nie?
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ależ słodko! Aż chce uszczypnąć twoje słodziutkie policzki!
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh boziu, ale z ciebie słodziak!
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Czy mogę cię zabrać do domu~?
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mniejsza z naszym kontraktem w takim razie.
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Próbujesz protestować, ale on jest o wiele za silny...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Baaaaaardzo dobrze się tobą zajmę, nyehehehe...
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Zdajesz sobie sprawę, że nie masz innego wyjścia.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: A zatem, łapiesz go za rękę.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nie masz pojęcia gdzie ta {i}nieludzka{/i} istota cię zabierze.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Ale zapewne wszędzie jest lepiej niż tutaj... racja?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm~ cóż zgaduje, że możesz mnie nazywać Błaznem!
blocks.speaker: who2pol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Przyjemność po mojej stronie, moja droga {i}Pani{/i}.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh? Więc jak mam się do ciebie odzywać w takim razie?
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Cóż, moja droga Pani, proszę zamknij swoje oczy.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Cóż, moja droga [mc], proszę zamknij swoje oczy.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Czujesz jego ciepłe ręce zakrywające twoje oczy.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ciepło zostaje nawet po tym jak jego dłoń opuściła twoją skórę.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tak szybko jak wyszeptał te słowa, jego obecność znika.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Zabawne słyszeć to od kogoś kto trzyma trupa na tyłach~
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: M-my tylko dostaliśmy rozkaz pozbycia się tego!
blocks.speaker: mannpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Czy myślisz, że mnie to obchodzi~?
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Chodź za mną, moja kochana Pani.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Zrównajmy ten świat z ziemią razem.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Niech to będzie nasza przysięga małżeńska.
blocks.speaker: jesterpol

blocks.source: Sua Alteza~ Hora de acordar~ Olá?
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Essa voz... Você não a reconhece.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: A última coisa de que se lembra é-

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ei? Ei? Ei? Você tá aí? Você já voltou do além?
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Vai, me diz se você foi de arrasta. Não me deixa aqui esperando!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, você acordou! Bom dia, bela adormecida!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Espero não ter interrompido seu cochilo, nyehehehe...!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Seria uma pena se eu atrapalhasse seu sono da beleza~
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Uou, alguém acordou do lado errado do chão!
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Você vai envelhecer mais rápido e seu corpo vai ficar todo enrugado, triste e acabado se irritando por qualquer coisinha!
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mas acho que não posso te julgar quando você tava dormindo nesse piso de madeira duro e frio...
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Por que você estava dormindo no chão?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Na verdade... Você estava dentro de um saco.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mas acho que é isso que se ganha por confiar cegamente nas pessoas.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, a doce e dolorosa traição~
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mas é aquilo, né? Uma vez um idiota, sempre um idiota!
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ei! Eu não disse que era você.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ahh, agora eu tô entediado. Você tá me entediando.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eu devia saber que responder ao chamado de um frescurento da nobreza seria perda de tempo.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Te vejo por aí! Não quero pegar um caso de tédio terminal~
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Antes que você pudesse dizer outra palavra, sua visão começa a escurecer.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Por quê? O que está acontecendo? O que há com você?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...E num piscar de olhos, sua vida se esvai.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sei lá. Foi você quem me chamou.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Uau. É assim que se trata um convidado?
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Foi você quem me invocou, boboca.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tá vendo mais alguém aqui? Não, né? Então quem mais poderia ser?
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Você desfere um tapa em seu rosto.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Uou. Na real, isso foi gostoso.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Talvez você tenha acordado algo inédito dentro dele.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Você bate de leve em sua bochecha.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Você novamente dá um tapinha em seu rosto.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Você lhe desfere um tapa com toda a sua força!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Já decidi. Vou fazer um contrato com você!
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eu não dou a mínima pro seu coração, mas-
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Quero me deliciar com a sua alma.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ele leva uma mão ao peito e faz uma reverência.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eu sou Jester, demônio da traição e dos pesadelos, ao seu dispor.
blocks.speaker: who2

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sou aquele que irá conceder seus mais profundos desejos... {i}mestre{/i}.

blocks.source: ¿Hey, hey, hey? ¿Estás con vida? ¿Aún estás con vida~?
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Dime si sigues muerto! Vamos, ¡no me dejes colgado!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh, despertaste. ¡No es momento para dormir!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Espero no haber arruinado tu sueño, ¡nyehehehe...!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sería una lástima si interrumpiese tu dulce descanso~
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Woah, alguien despertó con el pie izquierdo!
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Envejecerás en alguien de actitud amargada y triste si mantienes esa actitud!
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Pero no puedo culparte cuando has estado durmiendo sobre ese frío y duro piso de madera...
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¿Por qué estaba durmiendo en el piso?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: La verdad es que... saliste de ese saco.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Supongo que eso es lo que obtienes al confiar ciegamente en alguien.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Bueno, ¡basta ser tonto tan sólo una vez para siempre ser un tonto!
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hey, no me refería a ti.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Debí imaginarlo, sabía que responder al llamado de un nobre clase alta sería un desperdicio.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Estás por tu cuenta a partir de ahora.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Nos vemos! No quiero contagiarme de la estupidez que lleva la realeza~
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mi visión se vuelve borrosa antes de poder decir algo al respecto.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Pero eres consciente de que tu vida se está alejando.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Y así como así, todo ha terminado.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ni idea. Tú eres quien me llamó.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wow, ¿así es como tratas a un invitado?
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tú me invocaste, qué horrible eres.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¿Acaso hay alguien aquí además de ti? ¿De quién más estaría hablando?
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hmph... A decir verdad, eso se sintió bien.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Por desgracia, pareces haber despertado algo dentro de él.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Le das una palmada en su mejilla.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡¿Dónde está la pasión?! ¡¿Dónde está EL DRAMA?!
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Allí va otra palmada a medias.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: No estoy interesado en quedarme tu corazón, pero...
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Lleva una mano hacia su pecho y da una reverencia.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Soy Jester, el demonio de la traición y las pesadillas está a tu servicio.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Concederé tu más grande y profundo deseo... {i}Su majestad{/i}.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Al escuchar sus palabras sientes un dolor agudo penetrar en tu cabeza.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: El ser traicionado por tu más grande aliado.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un fuerte sentimiento nace y burbujea desde tu interior, lo que deseas es... {glitch=10.0}{size=+10}{b}{color=#e30000}{font=horrorspa.ttf}VENGANZA.{/font}{/color}{/b}{/size}{/glitch}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¿Les llevarás su perdición o te conformarás con una muerte sin sentido?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Este fue el inicio de una relación blasfema.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un demonio y su contratista, algo digno de sacrilegio.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Juntos, conducirán la destrucción y sufrimiento a su despertar.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, ¡pero que maravillosa sinfonía de venganza han creado!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm... Supongo que puedes llamarme Jester, sep.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Olías taaaan bien, ¡sólo vine volando tan rápido como una mosca hambrienta!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un alma pura corrompida por la traición es un raro descubrimiento.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sentí cómo hervía el desprecio en tu interior.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Supongo que bebí demasiado de ti y me llevé tus recuerdos también... whoops.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¿Quieres decir que estamos en el mismo bote?
blocks.speaker: yous

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Exacto, de eso estoy hablando! Y qué buen bote, ¡sigamos a bordo!
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...No puedo entender una palabra de lo que dices.
blocks.speaker: yous

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Aw, ¡qué dulce eres! Me estoy sonrojando.
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡Wow! ¿Eso quiere decir que el sentimiento es mutuo?
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Intentas resistirte, pero es demasiado fuerte...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Cuidaré muuuuuy bien de ti, nyehehehe...
blocks.speaker: who2s

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Eres consciente del hecho de no tener ningún otro lugar a dónde ir.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: No tienes idea de a dónde este ser {i}inhumano{/i} te llevará.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ...Pero obviamente, cualquier sitio es mejor que estar aquí... ¿cierto?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Su Majestad, ¡por favor cierre sus ojos!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Bueno, mi adorable [mc], ¡por favor cierra tus ojos!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sientes la calidez de su mano sobre tus ojos.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: El calor permanece incluso luego de que su mano se aparta de tu piel.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tan pronto como susurra esas palabras, su presencia desaparece.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Esto es divertido, escuchar eso de alguien que guardaba un cádaver allí detrás~
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ¡N-Nos pidieron disponer de él, nos lo ordenaron!
blocks.speaker: manns

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Que estos sean nuestros votos de compromiso.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}Suck it up and ask what's going on{/size}{/font}
blocks.speaker: old

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}'But we don't even know each other yet!'{/size}{/font}
blocks.speaker: old

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Агов? Агов? Агов? Ви живі? Ви ще живі?{/font}
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Скажіть мені, якщо ви все ще мертві, ну ж бо не затримуйте мене!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ох, ви встали. Прикидайся і співай, сонько!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Сподіваюся, я не сильно вас потурбував, ньехехехе...!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Було в соромно зіпсувати ваш солодкий сон~{/font}
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ви станете зморшкуватими, старими, втомленими та сумними набагато швидше, якщо завжди будете такими жорстокими!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Та я не можу звинувачувати вас, коли ви спали на цьому дуже сумному, холодному, твердому дереві...{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Гадаю, це те, що ви отримуєте за сліпу довіру.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ну що ж, блазень колись, блазень навіки!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Гей, я не про вас це говорив.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Я мав би здогадатися, що відповідати на виклик прискіпливого дворянина буде марною тратою часу.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Побачимось! Не хочу підхопити вашу королівську дурість~{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Перш ніж ви встигнете сказати ще одне слово, в ваших очах раптом починає темніти.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}-Але ви знаєте, що ваше життя вислизає.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Бачите тут ще когось? Ні? Тоді хто ще це може бути?{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ви дали йому ляпаса з усієї сили!{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Це воно. Я укладаю з вами контракт!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Він кладе руку на серце і вклоняється.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Джестер, Демон Зради та Кошмарів до ваших послуг.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Після його слів ви відчули гостру біль у голові.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Разом вони залишають за собою руйнування та страждання.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ах, але яку прекрасну симфонію помсти вони створюють!{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Угу... Думаю, ви можете називати мене Джестер. Так.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Від вас так смачно пахло, тож я прилетів, дзижчучи, як голодна муха!{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Чиста душа, зіпсована зрадою, - це такий рідкісний делікатес.{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Здається, я поглинув забагато і забрав ваші спогади разом із цим... йойк.{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Так, так! Такий гарний човен. Нехай цей корабель залишається на плаву!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}... Я не розумію ні слова із того, що ти сказав.{/font}
blocks.speaker: youuk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ой, як мило з твого боку! Я червонію.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ого! Невже це означає, що наші почуття взаємні?!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ой, ви дуже бадьорі, чи не так?{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Як мило! Я хочу пожамкати ваші пухкенькі щічки!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Тоді не звертайте уваги на наш контракт.{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ви намагаєтеся боротися, але він занадто сильний...{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Я буду дуууууже добре про вас піклуватися, ньехехехехе...{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}... Ви розумієте, що вам більше нікуди йти.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ви не уявляєте, куди вас приведе ця {i}нелюдська{/i} істота.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}-Але, напевно, будь-де краще, ніж тут... чи не так?{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Мгг~ тоді, думаю, ви можете називати мене Джестер!{/font}
blocks.speaker: who2uk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}О? Тоді як ви хочете, щоб я до вас звертався?{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ну тоді, мій любий майстре, будь ласка, заплющте очі.{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ну тоді, мій любий [mc], будь ласка, заплющте очі.{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Ви відчуваєте тепло його рук на ваших очах.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Жар залишився навіть після того, як його долоні покинули вашу шкіру.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Щойно він шепоче ці слова, його присутність зникає.{/font}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=text.ttf}Кумедно чути це від того, хто має мертве тіло позаду~{/font}
blocks.speaker: jesteruk

blocks.label: none

blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wie war noch gleich Dein Name?

blocks.source: Sag mir, ob Du noch tot bist. Komm schon, lass mich nicht hängen!

blocks.source: Oh, Du bist wach. Raus aus den Federn, Schlafmütze!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ich hoff' ich hab' Dich nicht gestört, nyehehehe...!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wär' jammerschade wenn ich Dir Deinen süßen Schlummer versaut hätte~
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Whoa, da ist aber jemand mit dem falschen Fuß zuerst aufgestanden!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du wirst umso schneller runzelig, alt, müde und traurig, wenn du immer so verrückt und mürrisch bist!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Kann ich Dir auch nich' vorwerfen, wenn Du auf diesem sehr traurigen, kalten, harten Holz geschlafen hast...
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.source: Warum hast Du auf dem Boden geschlafen?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eigentlich... bist Du aus einem Sack gekommen.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Schätze das ist es, was Du für blindes Vertrauen bekommst.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tja, einmal ein Narr, immer ein Narr!

blocks.speaker: youger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hey, ich hab nich' gesagt, dass ich Dich meine.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Jetzt is' mir langweilig. Du langweilst mich.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hätte wissen sollen, dass es Zeitverschwendung is', der Beschwörung eines zimperlichen Adeligen zu antworten.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du bist jetzt auf Dich allein gestellt.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Man sieht sich! Ich will mich nich' mit Deiner königlichen Dumpfheit anstecken~
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Bevor Du widersprechen kannst, wird Dir plötzlich schwarz vor Augen.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Warum? Was passiert hier? Was geht hier vor sich?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Aber Du weißt, dass Dir Dein Leben aus den Händen gleitet.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Keine Ahnung. Du hast mich hierher gerufen.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wow. Gehst Du so mit seinen Gästen um?
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du hast mich hierher beschworen. Fiesling.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Siehste sonst jemanden hier? Ne? Wer sonst könnte es sein?
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wow. Eigentlich hat sich das gut angefühlt.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Unglücklicherweise hast Du da vielleicht etwas in ihm erweckt.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du gibst ihm einen Klaps auf die Wange.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du gibst ihm einen weiteren, halbherzigen Klaps.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du schlägst ihn so fest Du nur kannst!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: WOOOW! Das hat sich so {b}{sc=2}GUT{/sc}{/b} angefühlt!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Also gut! Ich werd' einen Vertrag mit Dir machen!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ich interessier' mich nich' für Dein Herz, aber-
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Er legt eine Hand auf seine Brust und verbeugt sich.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Jester, Dämon des Verrats und der Alpträume, zu Deinen Diensten.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Das wird Dir Deine tiefste Sehnsucht gewähren... {i}Meister{/i}.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Während er spricht fühlst Du einen scharfen Stich in deinem Kopf.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ein starkes Verlangen kocht in Dir auf- {glitch=10.0}{size=+10}{b}{color=#e30000}{font=HorrorFont-Regular.ttf}RACHE{/font}{/color}{/b}{/size}{/glitch}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Aaah... so eine wunderschöne, verdorbene Seele!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eine Straße zur Verdammnis? Oder zu einem bedeutungslosen Tod?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Die Antwort ist recht eindeutig, nicht wahr?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Es war der Beginn einer ruchlosen Partnerschaft...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ein frevlerischer Dämon und sein Monarch.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Gemeinsam hinterlassen sie nichts als Zerstörung und Leid.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, aber was für eine wunderschöne Symphonie der Vergeltung sie erschaffen!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm... Ich denke Du kannst mich Jester nennen. Yup.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du hast so gut gerochen, also bin ich wie 'ne hungrige Fliege hierher geflattert!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Eine reine Seele, verdorben durch Verrat, ist so eine seltene Delikatesse.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: So viel Verachtung hat in Dir gebrodelt.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ich denke ich hab' zu viel davon geschlürft und Deine Erinnerungen mit raus gesogen... ups.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Also sitzen wir hier im selben Boot?
blocks.speaker: youger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ja, ja! Was für ein schönes Boot. Lass uns weiterschippern!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Ich verstehe kein Wort von dem, was Du sagst.
blocks.speaker: youger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hm? Spreche ich die falsche Sprache?
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: HÖR AUF! ICH VERSTEH DICH JA!
blocks.speaker: youger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh, wie süß von Dir. Ich werd' ganz rot.
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Whoa! Heißt das, es beruht auf Gegenseitigkeit?!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh, Du bist ja eine echte Frohnatur, hm?
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wie niedlich! Ich will Deine kleinen Wangen kneifen!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ich mag Dich jetzt schon, nyehehehe!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh Mann, Du bist so süüüüß!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Kann ich Dich mit nach Hause nehmen~?
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du versuchst Dich zu wehren, aber er ist viel zu stark...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ich werd' mich seeeehr gut um Dich kümmern, nyehehehe...
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Du stellst fest, dass Du nirgendwo sonst hin kannst.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du hast keine Ahnung, wo dieser {i}Unmensch{/i} Dich hinbringen wird.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Aber sicherlich ist es überall besser als hier... richtig?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm~ Ich schätze Du kannst mich Jester nennen!
blocks.speaker: who2ger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Freut mich, Dich kennen zu lernen, mein lieber {i}Meister{/i}.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh? Wie soll ich Dich dann ansprechen?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nun denn, teuerster Meister, bitte schließ Deine Augen.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Nun denn, [mc], bitte schließ Deine Augen.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Du fühlst die Wärme seiner Hand über Deinen Augen.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Die Hitze hält an, auch nachdem seine Handfläche Deine Haut verlassen hat.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: So schnell wie er die Worte gesprochen hatte, verschwindet seine Präsenz.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Lustig von jemandem, der eine Leiche transportiert~
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: W-wir wurden nur beauftragt, sie verschwinden zu lassen!
blocks.speaker: mannger

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Seh' ich aus als würde mich das interessieren~?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Lass uns gemeinsam die Welt niederreißen.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}Suck it up and ask what's going on{/size}{/font}
blocks.speaker: old

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}Akzeptiere es und frag, was hier los ist{/size}{/font}
blocks.speaker: new

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}'But we don't even know each other yet!'{/size}{/font}
blocks.speaker: old

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: {font=NovaSlim-Regular.ttf}{size=+10}'Aber wir kennen uns doch noch gar nicht!'{/size}{/font}

blocks.source: 嘿？嘿？嘿？你还活着吗？你还活——着吗？
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 如果你还活着请告诉我，求你了，不要一直晾着我！
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哦，你醒了。起床了，瞌睡虫！
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 希望我没有打扰到你，捏嘿嘿嘿……！
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 如果我打扰了你甜蜜的睡眠，那就太可惜了~
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 如果你总是这么古怪，那么你会更快地长皱纹、变老、疲倦和悲伤！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你一直睡在那凄凉、冰冷、坚硬的木头上，这也不能怪你…….
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 实际上……你是从麻袋里出来的。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我猜这就是你盲目信任的下场。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哦好吧，一日为愚，终身为愚！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 现在我感到无趣了。你真的让我厌烦。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我早该知道，回应一个挑剔贵族的召唤是一种浪费。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 再见!我不想抓住你皇家般的迟钝~
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你还没来得及说一句话，你的视线就突然开始暗下来了。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 为什么？发生什么事情了？这是怎么了？

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ——但是你知道你的生命正在消逝。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我不知道。是你把我召唤过来的。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哇哦，那就是你的待客之道？
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你召唤我来这的，小气鬼。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 这里还有其他人吗？没有？那还能是谁呢？
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我擦。 实际上，那感觉还不错。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ……你可能唤醒了他内心潜在的xp。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你又虚情假意地敲了他一下。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 芜湖! 那感觉太~ {b}{sc=2}棒{/sc}{/b}了！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 就这样。我要和你签订契约！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我对你的心脏不感兴趣，但是——
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 他将一只手放在胸前，鞠躬。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 小丑，背叛之恶魔，梦魇之王。
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 将满足你最深的渴望……{i}主人{/i}.
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 听了他的话，你觉得脑袋里一阵刺痛。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 被你最亲密的副官背叛。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 一个强烈的渴望从你的内心冒了出来—— {glitch=4}{sc=2}{size=+10}{color=#e30000}复仇{/color}{/size}{/sc}{/glitch}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 啊……多么美丽的、被玷污的灵魂！
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 通往地狱之路？还是无意义的死亡？
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 这是一段亵渎神明的搭档关系的开始……

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 一个亵渎神明的恶魔和他的君主。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 他们一起，在身后留下了毁灭和苦难。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 啊，但他们演奏了一首多么美妙的复仇交响曲啊！

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你闻起来太香了，所以我像饥饿的苍蝇一样嗡嗡叫着过来！
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 被背叛腐化的纯洁灵魂是如此难得的美味。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我猜我吸进去太多了，带走了你的记忆……哎呦。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 所以，我们现在是一条船上了吗？
blocks.speaker: youcn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 是的是的！好漂亮的船。让这艘船继续航行吧！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哇！这是不是意味着这种感觉是相互的？！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你知道这意味着什么吗？
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哦，你真是个爽朗的人，不是吗？
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 太可爱了！真想捏扁你的小脸蛋！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我已经喜欢上你了，捏嘿嘿嘿！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 人类宠物！多么让人愉悦！
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你试着挣扎，但是他的力气太大了……

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我会好好照顾你的，捏嘿嘿嘿……
blocks.speaker: who2cn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你不知道这个 {i}非人{/i} 会带你去哪里。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ——但显而易见，任何地方都比这里好……不是吗？

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 很高兴见到你，我亲爱的 {i}主人{/i}。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 那么现在，我亲爱的主人——
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 哦？你想让我怎么称呼你？
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 那么我亲爱的主人，请闭上你的眼睛。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 那么我亲爱的 [mc]，请闭上你的眼睛。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 你在你的眼睛上感受到了他的手的温暖。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 即使他的手掌离开了你的皮肤，那股热气依然挥之不去。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 他轻声说着这些话，他的存在感就逐渐消失了。

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 从一个在后面放着尸体的人嘴里说出来真有趣~
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我……我们只是被派去处理它！
blocks.speaker: manncn

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 我看起来像在乎这些的人吗~？
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 让我们一起夷平这个世界。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: 愿这是我们的结婚誓言。
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.source: Hey? Hey? Hey? Sei viva? Sei ancora vivaaa?
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Dimmi se sei ancora morta, forza non tenermi sulle spine!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh, ti sei svegliata. Ben alzato dormigliona!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Spero di non averti disturbata, nyehehehe...!
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sarebbe stato un peccato se avessi rovinato il tuo dolce riposo~
blocks.speaker: who

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Whoa, qualcuno si è svegliata di cattivo umore!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Comportandoti sempre cosi, ti trasformerai in una vecchia stanca, triste e rugosa ancor piu velocemente!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Beh non posso darti torto dal momento che ti sei addormentata sopra assi di legno fredde, tristi e soprattutto dure...
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: In verità... sei uscita da un sacco.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Credo che questo è ciò che si ottiene in cambio di assoluta e cieca fiducia.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh, beh, fregata una volta, fregata per sempre!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: A chi stai dando della sciocca?!
blocks.speaker: youit

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hey, non ho detto che era rivolto a te.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ora sono annoiato. Mi stai annoiando.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Avrei dovuto sapere che rispondere alla chiamata di un buon nobile sarebbe stato uno spreco.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ci vediamo! Non voglio che tu mi attacchi questa tua monotonia da nobile.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Prima che tu riesca ad aggiungere parola, la tua vista inizia ad oscurarsi.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Perchè? Che sta succedendo? Che mi sta capitando?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Ma ti rendi conto che la tua vita sta scivolando via.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Non so. Tu sei colei che mi ha chiamato.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wow. E' questo il modo di trattare un ospite?
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sei stato tu ad evocarmi. Cattiva
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Vedi forse qualcun'altro qui? No? Allora chi altro può esser stato?
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Gli dai un colpo in faccia.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Wowza. A dir la verità, è stato bello.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Potresto aver risvegliato un qualcosa di pericoloso dentro di lui.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Gli dai una leggera toccatina sulla guancia.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Gli dai un'altra botta sentra troppa convinzione.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ora lo schiaffeggi con tutta la tua forza!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: D'accordo. Ho deciso di stipulare un contratto con te.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Non sono interessato al tuo cuore, ma-
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Porta una mano al petto e si prostra in un inchino.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Jester, Demone degli Incubi e del Tradimento al tuo servizio.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Sono colui che farà avverare i tuoi piu profondi desideri... {i}padrona{/i}.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: In seguito alle sue parole, senti un acudo dolore nella tua testa.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Tradito da coloro a te piu cari.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: un forte desiderio inizia a manifestarsi dentro di te- {glitch=10.0}{size=+10}{b}{color=#e30000}{font=HorrorFont-Regular.ttf}VENDETTA {/font}{/color}{/b}{/size}{/glitch}

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Allunga la mano verso di te-

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Verso la strada della dannazione? O una morte senza senso?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: La risposta è abbastanza scontata, no?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Quella fu l'inizio della nostra macabra partnership...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un demone sacrilego e la sua monarchessa.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Insieme, porteranno ovunque distruzione e sofferenza.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ah, ma che bella sinfonia di vendetta che hanno creato!

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mhm... Puoi chiamarmi Jester. Si, credo.
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Hai un odore cosi gradevole, ne sono stato attirato come una mosca affamata!
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un'anima cosi pura, corrotta dal tradimento è sempre una delizia.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Credo che non esser riuscito a contenermi e, oltre a questo, mi sono impossessato anche dei tuoi ricordi... whoops.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Quindi, ora siamo sulla stessa barca?
blocks.speaker: youit

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Si Si! Davvero una bella barca. Continuiamo a farla navigare!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Non riesco a capire una sola parola di quello che stai dicendo.
blocks.speaker: youit

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Huh? Parlo forse una lingua a te sconosciuta?
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Whoa! Questo forse significa che il sentimento è reciproco?!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Aw, sei un tipo piuttosto allegro, vero?
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Che carino! Voglio darti un pizzicotto sulle guance!
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Provi a dimenarti, ma lui è troppo forte...

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Mi prenderò ottima cura di te , nyehehehe...
blocks.speaker: who2it

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: ... Ti rendi conto di non aver altro posto dove andare.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Non hai alcuna idea riguardo dove questo {i}essere{/i} deciderà di portarti.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: -Ma sicuramente qualunque posto sarà milgiore di questo... giusto?

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Piacere di fare la tua conoscenza , mio cara {i}padrona{/i}.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Oh? Come vuoi che ti chiami allora?
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Allora mio padrona, ora per favore chiudi gli occhi.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Allora [mc], ora per favore chiudi gli occhi.
blocks.speaker: jester

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Senti del calore della sua mano giusto sopra gli occhi.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un tepore percepibile anche in seguito al suo tocco sulla tua pelle

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Non appena pronuncia queste parole, la sua presenza sparisce improvvisamente.

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Un mostro...! No! No...! {sc=2}Non FATEMI del MALE...!{/sc}
blocks.speaker: mannit

blocks.label: none
blocks.source: Ironico, detto da qualcuno che trasporta un cadavere nel retro~
